BTSD-ACAD-0005.alt: Microscope photograph of a narrow flexible brown circuit with two rows of fine projecting carbon fibers; original 300-micrometre scale preserved.

This 2021 intracellular Aplysia study sharpens and PEDOT:pTS-coats tips; catalog 2020 configuration uses laser/plasma-exposed bare carbon. Label this difference visibly, and do not imply the 2021 intracellular stimulation result belongs to the 2015/2020 catalog cohorts.
